description:
Sr. UI Programmer to develop and maintain Insurance applications 
 Primary duties & responsibilities consist of: 
 Position will collaborate with internal clients, managers and developers in a team environment.
 Execute projects from initial concept through delivery.
 Application design and development.
 Assist in troubleshooting of final code.
   Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities Required: 
 C#
 User interface design and development
 WPF with MvvM
 ASP.Net MVC
 Web UI (HTML 5, CSS3, jQuery, LESS, KnockOut, Bootstrap, AngularJS)
 Rules-based development
 Object oriented design and programming
 Common building blocks and design patterns
 Problem-solving algorithms
 Strongly Preferred: 
 Prism, caliburn.micro, or other WPF framework
 Other nice to have experience: 
 Telerik/Kendo Controls
 Responsive design
 TDD
 NCalc
 Automated Testing
 Refactoring
 Insurance Industry
 

 Contract to Permanent (C2P) opportunity.  
 6m contract to hire. 

 Education & Work Experience: 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. 

 5+ years of .net and database experience required.
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
